messages:
maria: holding this PR until runtime confirms actual API behavior. docs state the /generate endpoint returns 400 when prompt is empty and allow_empty_prompt=false, but my local run returned 200 with an empty outputs array. this is a blocker for the migration guide and the example snippets. cc @kevin @sam
ci-bot: docs preview available: https://preview.docs.redwoodinference.local/pr/4321 
kevin: can you paste the exact request + response you saw? helps me repro quickly
maria: sure — curl I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","prompt":"","allow_empty_prompt":false}'
```
response: 200 OK
```
{"id":"r_abc","outputs":[],"meta":{"warnings":[]}}
```
kevin: huh. that doesn't match the spec we wrote. quick note: historically runtime accepted empty prompt for some models as a compatibility behavior. theres a compatibility flag around empty-prompt validation. i'll check cluster defaults and whether a recent change flipped it for the env you hit
sam: if runtime is going to keep returning 200 we should at least add an explicit note and example to the guide showing the empty-outputs case + how SDKs surface it. otherwise users will be confused when examples show a 400
liz: product preference is 400 (fail fast). if runtime can toggle a flag we should make the strict validation the default for new deployments. but for the docs release we need to decide: document reality first, then update when runtime flips behavior
kevin: quick update — reproduced locally and in staging. root cause: when "prefix_cache" is enabled, the validation path short-circuits and returns an accepted request with empty outputs to avoid breaking live traffic. strict validation is behind feature flag `strict-empty-prompt-validation`. on stable clusters that flag is OFF, so you see 200. i opened runtime ticket RNF-5921 to make the flag default-on for new clusters and to provide migration guidance. ETA: EOD for a rollout plan, longer for universal flip.
maria: thanks. for the PR I'm going to add an explicit note in the generate API page and the migration guide: current runtime may return 200 + empty outputs for empty prompt when prefix_cache compatibility is enabled; behavior may become 400 in future when strict validation flag is enabled. marking the PR as "hold - runtime confirmation added" and linking RNF-5921. will remove the note once runtime flips default.
ci-bot: preview updated: https://preview.docs.redwoodinference.local/pr/4321/preview-2
kevin: SGTM. i'll post the rollout doc in the ticket and ping this thread once we flip the flag in staging.
maria: perfect — thanks everyone. leaving hold comment and tagging reviewers to pause merge (adding TODO in PR body). :thumbsup:
